changes.text: A redesigned site, with the Wire as the front page: headlines written from real channel and market numbers.
New stock pages with channel charts, supply, and each week's dividend review.
Saturday dividend reviews: holders are paid, or charged, on each channel's week, and max shares reset.
Games: talent cards and a collection, card duels, High-Low, multiplayer blackjack, the capsule machine, and a card exchange.
Prediction markets, notifications, profile banners and portfolio themes.
